Alice Chen: CI red on macOS shard after the toolchain image roll. Failing target //libs/bar:bar_shared_test — link errors during final link: undefined symbol _bar_init in libbar.dylib. cc @Ben L. @Cheng Wu. job: https://ci.redwood.company/runs/12345 :frowning:

ci-bot: buildkite: job 12345 failed on macos-clang-13 (exit 1). logs: https://ci.redwood.company/logs/12345 — artifact: build/logs/libbar_link.txt

Ben L.: hmm, that sounds like an install_name/SONAME mismatch rather than missing object. Did the toolchain image change ld/ld64 defaults or symbol visibility? Can you paste the linker error lines and the link command?

Alice Chen: ```
/Applications/Xcode/Toolchains/XCToolchain/usr/bin/ld -dylib -o libbar.dylib -install_name /usr/local/lib/libbar.dylib ... -L/opt/sdk/lib -lfoo
Undefined symbols for architecture x86_64:
  "_bar_init", referenced from:
      _test_main in test_main.o
ld: symbol(s) not found for architecture x86_64
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
```

Cheng Wu: quick checks: run `otool -L` on the produced lib to see its install_name, and `nm -gU` to verify bar_init is exported. If the lib was accidentally versioned (libbar.1.dylib) or install_name changed, tests that link against a specific name can break. Also check CMake properties: SOVERSION/VERSION or any custom LINK_FLAGS we pass.

Dana R.: I repro locally by swapping to the new image — build fails the same. Workaround: setting target properties helped: `set_target_properties(bar PROPERTIES VERSION 1.2 SOVERSION 1)` or manually adding `-Wl,-install_name,@rpath/libbar.dylib` to link flags lets the test link. Not a long-term fix though. @Ben any clue what changed in the image?

Ben L.: looks like the image rolled a newer ld64 that now defaults differently for -install_name when CMake doesn't set SOVERSION. I'll open an infra PR to pin the previous image for the macos-cluster while we triage. For now we should try a bisect across the image tags to confirm. @ci-bot can you run a rerun on the previous macos image (macos-clang-12) for job 12345 and queue a bisect job across images 2026-02-20..2026-03-12?

ci-bot: buildkite: rerun requested: job 12345 on macos-clang-12 (rollback test) — queued. Bisect across image tags 2026-02-20..2026-03-12 requested, will report back with the first failing image.

Alice Chen: thanks — I'll hold the release checklist on this until we get the rollback/bisect result. If bisect shows the image is the culprit, we'll either pin image for release or add explicit SOVERSION rules in CMake to be robust. Posting a minimal repro and opening a tracking ticket after rerun completes. :thumbsup:
